verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say Marlin works autonomously, without further human input, for up to roughly eight hours after a brief scoping exchange. It can be cancelled mid-run and carries the research through to a finished report and slides, so the long unattended job is well covered. Nothing in the pack shows how the analyst is told the result is ready, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: any documented completion notification (email, in-app or webhook), independent or hands-on confirmation of long unattended runs.
